name: 企业（整体/股权/资产）评估

map.企业价值评估工具，采用资产基础法计算企业整体价值，输入总资产和总负债得出净资产价: A business valuation tool using the asset-based approach: enter total assets and total liabilities to derive net asset value, with equity value by ownership percentage.
map.📖 查看「企业（整体/股权/资产）评估 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Business, Equity and Asset Valuation User Guide"
map.企业价值 = 资产 − 负债（或收益法）: Business value = assets − liabilities (or the income approach)
map.资产基础法适用于资产重置成本易于确定的企业: The asset-based approach suits businesses whose asset replacement cost is easy to establish
map.股权价值=企业整体价值×股权比例: Equity value = total business value × equity stake
map.溢价/折价需根据控制权、流动性等因素确定: Premium or discount is set by reference to control, liquidity and similar factors
map.无形资产占比高时建议结合收益法评估: Where intangibles are a large share, combine with the income approach
map.并购重组时按资产基础法估算企业整体价值。: Estimate whole-business value by the asset-based approach in M&A and restructuring.
map.股权转让定价时计算对应比例股权价值。: Compute the value of the corresponding equity stake when pricing a transfer.
map.无形资产占比高时提示改用收益法。: It flags a switch to the income approach when intangibles dominate.
map.总资产 1000 万、负债 400 万 → 净资产 600 万；溢价 10% →: Total assets 10 million yuan and liabilities 4 million yuan give net assets of 6 million; with a 10% premium, total business value = 600 × 1.1 = 6.6 million; the value of a 60% stake = 660 × 60% = 3.96 million.
map.若负债率=400/1000=40% 属健康；若负债率达 75%，整体价值虽同但财: A debt ratio of 400/1000 = 40% is healthy; at 75% the total value is unchanged but financial risk is high, so the conclusion should note a discount.
map.资产基础法有什么局限？: What are the limits of the asset-based approach?
map.它只反映账面价值加减溢价，忽略商誉与未来盈利，轻资产或高成长企业会显著低估，宜结: It only reflects book value plus or minus a premium, ignoring goodwill and future earnings, so asset-light or high-growth businesses are materially understated; combine it with the income approach.
map.溢价率怎么取？: How is the premium rate set?
map.参考近期可比交易、协同效应与控股权溢价，通常 0%–30%，需在报告中说明依据。: Reference recent comparable transactions, synergies and control premium, usually 0%-30%, and state the basis in the report.
map.企业价值评估工具采用资产基础法计算企业整体价值，输入总资产、总负债和无形资产，计: The business valuation tool uses the asset-based approach: enter total assets, total liabilities and intangibles to derive net asset value, with equity value by stake and premium/discount adjustment.
